metadata.title: Physical AI: Jensen's ChatGPT Moment, Four Robot Types, and Why the Brain Is Still the Bottleneck
metadata.guest_role: Sell-side / coverage of humanoid and Physical-AI supply chain since 2022

conclusion: Yongqing sits with sell-side friend Xiao X, who has tracked Tesla's robot since the June 2022 prototype and interviewed 100+ suppliers. Jensen's CES 2026 line — machines that understand, reason, and act — is Physical AI's ChatGPT moment. Hardware is usable: Tesla wants >95% planetary-roller-screw efficiency, industry <85%. The brain is the jam: long-horizon pass <50%, and after three hours of motor heat a 95% short-run can fall to ~80%. A million 100k-RMB humanoids is only ~4% of China's 25M car year — rich for auto-parts multiples unless volume is a flow, not a stock.
background: AI 'second half' after models and data-center infra. Four machine types ranked by landing: industrial > cobot > humanoid > general embodied. Xiao X sat auto/ADAS until Tesla's proto, then never left robots. Ego-scale (human video + real-robot correction + sim) and headset data (housewives, line workers, SF Express) are the scaling bets. Recording date on tape is 2026-08-01; published 2026-08-25.
important_facts: Definitions and guest: 2024 Jensen — next AI is Physical AI that understands physics and works beside you. CES 2026 — ChatGPT moment when machines understand, reason, and act. Xiao X: broker/sell-side, Tesla Optimus-class coverage from 2022-06, 100+ interviews from materials and actuators through mid-stack cerebellum/brain to body OEMs. Four types: industrial (pre-programmed, weakest generality) < cobot (vision, can move stations on one line) < humanoid (factory-wide gaps, more DOF, brain chip + actuator modules) < general embodied (multi-task; not all embodied is humanoid). One robot + two debug engineers cannot scale into thousands per plant.

Bottlenecks: planetary roller screws — Tesla spec >95% transmission efficiency, industry often <85% on materials/process; usable on humanoids, not the main jam. Brain has two watchables: long-horizon programs and action reliability. Long-program pass rate is still <50%. Short runs can be 90%+ accurate / 95% 'cool' rate, then past three hours motor heat changes the sensor/control program so the same skill drops toward ~80%. Driving still has not delivered L4 on four degrees of freedom; daily life and factory data are larger. A Zhiyuan-group data shop (whisper: 密封, likely 觅蜂) targets 10B hours by 2030 — about 20,000 human lifetimes — and even that may not generalize; some talk of 10 million people. Scaling law still holds if data can be standardized.

Data and TAM: Ego Scale mixes human demonstration video, real-robot correction, and sim. Headset capture is the cheap standardized path — 20k hours already helped, so the chain wants 100k / 1M / 10M hours from housewives, factory workers, and SF Express riders wearing rigs at work. Volume: bipedal humanoids alone may not hit a million; wheeled plus toys could. Pure factory ToB tops out around a million units; 10M/year needs home (security, nanny, housekeeping). At 100k RMB/unit, 1M installed is ~4% of China's 25M car year — auto-parts comps look rich unless you underwrite one-unit-per-year flow (4× the auto market). 2022–24 the tape says the chain was mispriced on incomplete information.

mental_model.name: Physical-AI GPT Moment × Brain Pass Rate × Auto-TAM Ceiling
mental_model.components: Treat Jensen's CES line as the category clock, not a shipment print. Rank machines by generality: industrial, cobot, humanoid, embodied. Hardware gaps (85% vs 95% screws) are real and still secondary. Watch long-horizon <50% and three-hour heat fade as the software tell. Scaling needs standardized hours (headsets, Ego Scale), not more random teleop. Size the market as a flow: 1M×100k RMB is a sliver of China auto unless homes open.
mental_model.application: TSLA is the spec-setter (screws, proto, brain workload) and still brain-limited. NVDA is the Physical-AI slogan owner, not a BOM tape here. Do not pay auto-parts multiples for a 1M-unit stock of 100k robots. Fade 'humanoid L5 before robotaxi L4' without a data-hour plan. Headset/Ego-scale vendors are the 2026–30 diligence, even if the name on tape is garbled.

key_insights.view: The screw gap is not the killer.
key_insights.question: What is?
key_insights.answer: Tesla wants >95% planetary-roller efficiency; industry is <85%. Usable. Long-horizon brain pass <50% and three-hour heat fade are the jams.

key_insights.question: Why four types?
key_insights.answer: Industrial is pre-programmed; cobots move on a line; humanoids cover factory gaps; embodied is multi-task. Landing order is the reverse of the story.

key_insights.question: How should investors size?
key_insights.answer: 100k RMB × 1M ≈ 4% of 25M cars. Rich for a stock of parts unless volume is annual flow or homes open to 10M.

top_investment_implications.thesis: Spec-setter since the 2022 proto; 95% screw and brain metrics are still its factory, and the brain is not done — medium
Jensen's Physical-AI ChatGPT-moment frame is the category clock on this tape, not a robot BOM — low
